children: rose 10.13% intraday after Needham named it one of five semiconductor beneficiaries of the co-packaged optics ramp, following a five-day visit to SEMICON Taiwan 2026. The firm describes CPO as the single most important technology transition for solving AI's networking bottleneck through 2028 and beyond, with AXT's indium phosphide substrate business at the center of it.

The numbers behind the call are from July. AXT reported record second-quarter revenue of $47.6 million, up roughly 165% year over year, returning to profitability with gross margin expanding to nearly 45%. Needham upgraded the stock to Buy with a $90 target in late July, and Northland Capital Markets later raised its own target to $125.

title: AXT Rises 10% After Being Named Co-Packaged Optics Winner
